# Imported source

`arc-cua/` contains **all 100 tracked files**, unchanged, from
<https://github.com/shhivv/arc-cua> at
`74ffae1108b1cb4b1f6b161084af12646f544ba5` (version 0.1.1).
This includes code, tests, fixtures, examples, benchmarks, docs, site, lock file and
the original [MIT license](arc-cua/LICENSE). It excludes the clone's Git database
and generated/local files. Copyright and license notices remain unchanged.

[Import manifest](arc-cua.BIMAX_IMPORT.json) records every file's Git blob, mode,
size and SHA-256. Keep Bimax-specific metadata outside the upstream snapshot so
changes are distinguishable from the original source.

This is a source import. No dependency was installed, MCP server registered,
native permission requested, or app/engine route connected. Python/PyObjC code is
not a drop-in TypeScript replacement. Runtime integration and native qualification
remain unimplemented. See [record 77](../docs/product-reset/77_CU_SOURCE_IMPORT_RECORD.md).
